title: 12″ Dopezilla Cerberus Water Pipe – Milky Purple
description:
Description
Part of this fun collection is Cerberus, a clear straight tube ice bong with a coloured accent on the bowl, base, mouthpiece and custom monster logo is extremely easy to clean and maintain. The honeycomb percolators makes the hit incredibly smooth. It features a bullet hole ice notch, for optimal filtration with a frosty touch.
The Cerberus straight tube comes delivered with a male 14.5mm herb bowl with handle. The handle not only makes it easy to lift the bowl, without the risk of burning your fingers, but it doubles as a roll stopper as well.
So if you are on the lookout for a solid and unique straight tube ice bong to add to your glass collection, you have found your perfect match.
High quality borosilicate glass.
Straight tube.
14.5mm ground joint.
Coloured 14.5mm herb bowl with handle.
Bullet-hole ice pinch.
No carb hole.
Colourful accents on the mouthpiece, bowl, base and monster logo.
